svg.title: SHIELD — Anti-Scam Ai On Aws
svg.desc: SHIELD: Scam-detection platform for senior citizens with a DynamoDB Scam Fingerprint Network and Hindi voice-first, accessibility-focused interfaces. 4.2s was 8 minutes; 91% accuracy; 97% lower API cost Tech: Bedrock, Textract, Polly, DynamoDB, EC2.
